---
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# GEOTEC Journal Club – session minutes template
# Copy this file as sessions/YYYY-MM-DD-firstauthor.qmd and fill in
# the YAML fields below; the header table is built from them.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
title: "APA citation"
subtitle: "Session NN · YYYY-MM-DD"
description: "Paper title"
date: 2026-01-01            # session date (YYYY-MM-DD)
lang: en
categories: [journal-club]  # add keywords, e.g. [journal-club, remote-sensing, GeoAI]

session:
  number: NN
  time: "11:00–12:15"
  facilitator: "Name Surname"
  note-taker: "Name Surname"

paper:
  authors: "Surname, A., Surname, B."
  year: 2025
  title: "Paper title"
  venue: "Journal or preprint server"
  doi: "10.xxxx/xxxxx"
  url: "https://doi.org/10.xxxx/xxxxx"
  pages: 12
  type: "regular"           # regular | classic | preprint | controversial

format:
  html:
    toc: true
    theme: cosmo
  typst:
    papersize: a4
    geometry: margin=2.5cm
---

## Discussion

### Scientific contribution

- *What is new? Is the claim supported by the evidence?*
- *Strengths:*
- *Weaknesses / limitations (acknowledged or not by the authors):*

### Methods, design and validation

- *Is the method appropriate to the question? Could it be reproduced (data, code, parameters)?*
- *How is the result validated? What alternative design would we have chosen?*

### Writing and presentation

- *Structure, clarity of the abstract and introduction, use of figures and tables.*
- *Something worth imitating in our own papers:*
- *Something to avoid:*
